gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes for the plan shape of an enlarged column head or cap, used for the value of the headShape property of diggs:RIColumnHead. The shape is what makes a single plan dimension interpretable: headWidth is the side of a square, the diameter of a circle, or the smaller side of a rectangle, and those differ in plan area. Deliberately NOT diggs:PileShapeEnumExtType, which describes a pile's structural cross section and carries values meaningless for a cap ("circular open", "square hollow"). Built at W1 - see docs/build/W1/NOTES.md.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Column Head Plan Shape Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A square head, whose plan dimension headWidth is the length of one side. The most common cap form in rigid inclusion practice, since a square cap tessellates a square or rectangular column grid.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Square

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A rectangular head, requiring both headWidth (the smaller plan dimension) and headLength (the larger). Used where the column grid spacing differs between the two horizontal axes.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Rectangular

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A circular head, whose plan dimension headWidth is the diameter. Typical where the cap is cast by enlarging the top of the column bore rather than formed separately.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Circular
